changelog: Fixed: 'Node.js is required in the local terminal to run browser extensions' error on the plugin pages
The plugin host now starts with the Node.js inside the Ubuntu container (through proot), so plugins load their tools and skills
Fixed: Stdio MCP servers (npx/node based) now get the container PATH instead of Termux paths, so they can start
App name now shows as CodeNexus in the drawer and in the settings help texts, and the accessibility service name matches Android Settings
Every CodeNexus fix is re-applied automatically after the daily upstream sync
Launcher icon is the original AntiGem prism gem, app name stays CodeNexus
Updates install over the previous version without uninstalling (stable signing key)
